title: kbmon's shared snapshot is one per checkout, not one per clone as its goal says, and the pane's receipt and needs-you runs stay unshared
goal: Either kbmon's shared snapshot lives once per clone (the main checkout's _cache) or the docs and goal say one per checkout; and the pane's --receipt and --status all runs on an alert change take the shared snapshot or are named as per-pane

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import inspect, kbmon
src = inspect.getsource(kbmon)
assert 'git-common-dir' in src or 'common_dir' in src, 'the shared snapshot path is the checkout root, not the clone'

repro_reason: the gap is where one path points (checkout root against the clone's common directory); the path expression in the code is what decides it
notes: Review gap 4 of SP-wpttdu7u: kbmon.py:93 and shared() use a.root.resolve()/_cache/kbmon/shared.json; register.tsx lines 111 and 166 run --receipt and notifyNeeds runs --status all per pane.
